analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 45.4 maintains neutral territory, while MACD histogram shows improvement (-0.6726 to -0.2962), indicating a bottoming phase. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 5 consecutive days. A Higher Low pattern is forming as the price has risen to $150.18 from the 5-day low of $141.48. Trading volume is subdued at 0.37x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in directional confirmation. The weekly ADX at 17.3 signals a non-trending phase, cautioning against confusing short-term daily adjustments with broader trends. While the overall market (QQQ) saw a sharp +2.7% rebound, this ETF remains below its SMA200 with a bearish EMA stack alignment. Therefore, a wait-and-see stance is maintained.
